बॉस! यश की तो चांदी हो गई है भाई! 🎬
Koimoi Star Ranking में यश ने आमिर खान को पछाड़ दिया है। 🤩
फिल्म Ramayana के 1000 crore club में एंट्री मारते ही यश का स्कोर 1550 points हो गया है।
इससे पहले फिल्म के 900 crore club में जाने पर यश के 1450 points थे।
इस शानदार छलांग के साथ यश ने 1500 points वाले आमिर खान को पीछे छोड़ दिया है। 💥
अब यश Koimoi Star Ranking के टॉप 7 में शामिल हो गए हैं।
रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक Toxic की नाकामी के बाद यश के लिए यह जबरदस्त कमबैक है।
हालांकि अगला टारगेट अजय Devgn (2300 points) तक पहुंचना नामुमकिन बताया जा रहा है। 🤔
तो क्या यश आने वाले समय में अजय Devgn को भी पछाड़ पाएंगे? 💬

ctx.title: Box Office: Yash Overtakes Aamir Khan In Koimoi Star Ranking As Ramayana Enters 1000 Crore Club!
ctx.summary:
With Ramayana entering the 1000 crore club at the Indian box office, Yash has gained 100 more points in the Koimoi Star Ranking. 
 The post  Box Office: Yash Overtakes Aamir Khan In Koimoi Star Ranking As Ramayana Enters 1000 Crore Club!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Like everyone else associated with Ramayana, Yash has benefited immensely. In the Koimoi Star Ranking, he had already witnessed a big surge in the points tally, and now, with the film making a smashing entry into the 1000 crore club, he has crossed Aamir Khan ‘s tally to enter the top 7 in the Star Ranking. This is an impressive comeback for the actor after the debacle of Toxic. Keep reading for a detailed report!
For the unversed, in Koimoi’s Star Power Index, aka Star Ranking, actors are allotted points based on their films (Bollywood/Hindi) in the coveted box-office clubs (based on Indian collections only), such as the 100 crore club, 200 crore club, and more. For example, 100 points are awarded for a film in the 100-crore club, and so on. 50 points each are given for a film in the top 10 overseas grossers of Bollywood. In the case of South Indian films, only the Hindi-dubbed version’s collection is considered.
After Ramayana entered the 900 crore club, Yash was standing at 1450 points. Now, with the film crossing the 1000 crore mark at the Indian box office in net collections, he has gained 100 more points, taking his total to 1550 points . With this surge, he has surpassed Aamir Khan ( 1500 points ) to secure the seventh spot in the Koimoi Star Ranking, which is a huge achievement.
With Ramayana, surpassing Aamir Khan is the last achievement for Yash, as the next target, Ajay Devgn ( 2300 points ), is out of reach. To overtake Ajay, Ramayana must enter the 1800 crore club, which is impossible.
